title: Grok pager appearance configuration (~/.grok/pager.toml)
description: Schema for ~/.grok/pager.toml (path resolved via display_user_grok_path("pager.toml")), the pager-owned, hot-reloadable appearance/rendering config. Models the TOML-facing RawAppearanceConfig; every section carries #[serde(default)] so any subset of keys is valid and an empty file is valid. No struct uses deny_unknown_fields, so unknown keys are tolerated everywhere. The settings-modal registry (crates/codegen/xai-grok-pager/src/settings/) is deliberately NOT part of this schema: 43 of its 46 entries persist into [ui]/[cli]/[toolset.ask_user_question] of ~/.grok/config.toml (see grok-config.schema.json); the single registry entry that writes to pager.toml is [scrollback.scroll].respect_manual_folds.

disable_plugins.description: Disable hooks & plugins UI (/hooks and /plugins commands, scrollback annotations).

show_plan_chip.description: Always show the "plan" chip in the status bar when plan content is available, even after the user exits plan mode.

optionalColor.description: OptionalColor: "none"/"null" (case-insensitive) for no override, a named palette color (e.g. "BLUE", "CYAN", "MAGENTA", "COMMENT"; case-insensitive, GrokNight palette), a hex string ("#rrggbb" or "#rgb"), or an [r, g, b] array of three 0-255 integers. An unrecognized color name or malformed hex FAILS the parse.

oneOf.description: "none"/"null", "#rgb"/"#rrggbb" hex, or a named palette color.

alt_screen.description: Alt-screen (fullscreen) policy: "auto" = fullscreen in plain terminals and normal tmux, inline in tmux control mode and Zellij; "always"; "never". Any other string fails the parse (typed enum).

minimal.description: Experimental scrollback-native rendering mode: finalized blocks are printed into the terminal's native scrollback.

minimal_live_rows.description: Pinned live-region height (rows) for minimal mode. Optional; default-at-use 10.

minimal_max_commit_rows.description: Maximum rows for a single committed block in minimal mode. Optional; default-at-use 2000.

fps.description: Animation frame rate (ticks per second). Higher = smoother but more CPU. Documented range 1-60, clamped at use; serde accepts any u8 (0-255).

wave_rows.description: Rows per wave cycle for accent line animation. Lower = faster wave; min 1 applied at use.

show_fps.description: Show an FPS counter overlay in the top-right corner. Requires a debug build; also enabled by GROK_FPS=1.

promptView.description: Prompt input view settings — the prompt editor widget at the bottom of the screen, NOT the user prompt block inside the scrollback (see scrollback.blocks.prompt).

collapse_unfocused.description: Collapse the prompt to its minimum single-line height when focus is in the scrollback pane.

mouse_hover.description: Show hover highlight box when mousing over the prompt widget.

show_prefix.description: Show the prompt prefix character in the prompt editor.

scrollback.description: Scrollback pane settings (layout, scrollbar, scroll, blocks, display).

outer_hpad_left.description: Left horizontal padding for outer viewport (min 1 applied at use).

outer_hpad_right.description: Right horizontal padding for outer viewport (min 1 applied at use).

block_pad_left.description: Padding after accent line, before content.

block_pad_right.description: Padding after content, at right edge.

gap_left.description: Gap between content/selection edge and scrollbar track; 0 = adjacent to content.

gap_right.description: Gap between scrollbar track and screen edge; 0 = scrollbar at screen edge.

scrollbar_bg.description: Override scrollbar background color; "none" = theme default.

scrollbar_fg.description: Override scrollbar foreground/thumb color; "none" = theme default.

margin.description: Minimum lines of context to keep above/below the selected entry when navigating; 0 = scroll to edge.

min_page_fraction.description: Minimum scroll as percentage of viewport height (documented 0-100, clamped at use; serde accepts any u8). 0 = minimal scroll, 25 = quarter page, 100 = full page.

follow_indicator.description: Follow indicator in the gap row below scrollback: "none" = hidden, "center" = centered marker when content is below the viewport. Typed enum — other strings fail the parse.

follow_auto_select.description: When follow mode scrolls to new content, auto-select the latest entry.

follow_by_overscroll.description: Scrolling past the bottom (j, Ctrl-D, page-down, mousewheel) engages follow mode.

anchor_on_fold.description: Anchor scroll on fold: keep the toggled block's header at the same screen y.

respect_manual_folds.description: Opt-in: keep manually folded blocks as-is during streaming/completion, and stop auto-scroll when a fold expands a block while following. Also editable via the /settings registry — the one registry entry persisted to pager.toml rather than config.toml.

line_under_last_entry.description: Render a subtle horizontal line below the last entry (end-of-content marker).

collapsed_accent_char.description: Accent character for collapsed groupable blocks; the built-in glyph is "❙" (U+2759), degraded to "|" on legacy Windows consoles.

dim_accent.description: Blend factor for dimmed accents on collapsed groupable blocks (0.0-1.0).

group_selection_split.description: Group selection box mode: true = "split" (Mode B), false = "always" (Mode A).

highlight_overlays_border.description: Whether the active-block highlight overlays selection box borders.

expandable_indicator.description: Show the expand indicator on selected foldable collapsed entries.

expandable_indicator_running.description: Show the expand indicator on running entries in their minimum fold mode.

selection_buttons.description: Show copy/open buttons on the selection box.

sticky_headers.description: Pin user prompts as sticky headers when scrolled past.

tab_width.description: Spaces used when expanding tab characters in content; 0 passes tabs through unchanged.

group_max_visible.description: Maximum visible entries in a consecutive group of collapsed tool/thinking blocks; older entries hide behind a compact header; 0 = disable.

blocks.description: Block rendering settings, one sub-table per block type.

accent.description: Accent color for the vertical line; "none" disables.

gutter_bg.description: Diff line background extends to include the gutter (line numbers).

indent_bg.description: true = skip indent columns in diff line background; false = include indent.

line_summary.description: Show the +N/-M line summary in the collapsed header. Unset follows the [ui] collapsed_edit_blocks flag in config.toml.

expanded_by_default.description: Start Edit blocks expanded (showing the diff). Unset follows the [ui] collapsed_edit_blocks flag in config.toml.

dual_line_numbers.description: Show two line-number columns (old + new) like GitHub's unified diff.

prompt.description: User prompt block rendering inside the scrollback (NOT the prompt editor widget).

accent_bg.description: Accent column gets the block's background.

min_lines.description: Minimum content lines shown in truncated/sticky header mode (excludes vpad).

show_prefix.description: Show the prefix character before the prompt text.

accent.description: Accent color for the vertical line; "none" = theme default (gray_dim).

accent_enabled.description: Whether the accent line is shown at all.

bg_blend.description: Blend factor for markdown colors with background (documented 0-100 scale; serde accepts any u8).

truncated_lines.description: Visual lines shown at start and end in truncated mode (min 1 applied at use).

animate.description: Accent line animates (traveling wave) while thinking is active.

header.description: Show the header line ("Thinking..." / "Thought for Xs") in truncated/expanded modes.

header_bright.description: Header uses brighter styling in non-collapsed modes (like tool titles); false = always dim gray.

tool.description: Tool call block rendering (Read, Search, ListDir, etc.).

muted_collapsed.description: Collapsed tool calls render entirely in muted gray.

dim_details.description: Parenthetical details use the dimmest gray (gray_dim).

bullet.description: Bullet/icon before tool call headers. Typed enum RawToolBullet (kebab-case) — other strings fail the parse.

terminal_bg.description: Output has a terminal-style dark background.

first_lines.description: Output lines shown at the start in truncated mode (min 1 applied at use).

last_lines.description: Output lines shown at the end in truncated mode (min 1 applied at use).

running_accent.description: Accent color for running execute blocks (animated wave); "none" = theme accent_running (MAGENTA-family).

header_style.description: Header display style: "shell" = `$ command`, "label" = `Run command`. Struct default is "label" (the enum's own #[default] is Shell, but RawExecuteConfig::default() sets Label).

muted_command_collapsed.description: Command text is muted/uncolored when collapsed.

badge_format.description: Badge format in the status bar: "default" = colored numbers only, "colon" = icon:count, "comma" = count icon comma-separated. Typed enum — other strings fail the parse.
